name: Toomi Kokona
source: A first-year who is a member of the Life Research Club. Because of her nature being easily push around is often used as female example for club. Said to have the largest bust of female members. Is the only member to not be blacked mailed into  joining club. She has a weakness of being compliant when people are consistently pushing her. Momoka witness this event first hand at grocery sales man and shortly after asked her to join club...after asking several times.
